body.purpose: Default running text, set at the body element.

label.purpose: Form labels, nav labels, pills, badges.

shadows.name: ambient-panel
shadows.purpose: Default resting shadow under cards and the .card / .dapp-panel utilities.

shadows.name: connect-wallet-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary-tinted lift reserved for the wallet-connect control only.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition timing for hovers, nav pills, and borders across the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid brand-red button for the single primary action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; font-weight: 600; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); transition: background 180ms ease, filter 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent); filter: brightness(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.95); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered card-surface button; the default button variant across the app.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 70%, transparent); font-weight: 600; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; transition: background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--secondary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default form field with icon slot, focus ring, and inline error support.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 70%, transparent); background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; transition: box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted-foreground) 70%, transparent); } .ds-input:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Content Panel
components.description: The primary content-card wrapper used across dashboard sections.
components.css: .ds-panel { border-radius: 32px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 85%, transparent); background: var(--card); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px -40px color-mix(in srgb, var(--background) 85%, transparent); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-panel-value { margin: 0; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; color: var(--foreground); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Icon-only rail item; bordered accent pill when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px; border-radius: 16px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 68%, transparent); transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--secondary) 75%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-item-active { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Low-emphasis rounded metadata chip, e.g. status counts or chain labels.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 88%, transparent); padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 0.73rem; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

narrative.overview: The AquaStock dApp is where a client checks what they have and moves it. Every surface is built to be read in one glance and acted on in one tap: a balance, a status, an action — never a chart to interpret or a protocol to operate. The current implementation leans on a single warm, matte red-orange (oklch(0.54 0.22 28)) as its primary color against a warm off-white canvas, carried consistently through buttons, active nav states, and focus rings. This system explicitly rejects a crypto-terminal aesthetic: no neon gradients, no glassmorphism as a default surface treatment, no dense DeFi-protocol chrome (staking/governance/treasury language and layout), no token-price decoration, and no literal Peru-flag imagery. It also rejects a sterile corporate-bank feel — surfaces stay soft-edged and tactile, not boxy.
keyCharacteristics: One warm accent color carrying primary actions, active states, and focus rings — not yet split into a decisive red + informational blue as docs/VISUAL.md intends.
Soft, deep-rounded panels (dapp-panel at 32px) over hard-edged cards.
Geist as the single sans-serif voice across display and body text.
OKLCH as the canonical color format throughout globals.css.

rules.name: The One-Red Rule (current state, to retire)
rules.body: Primary and accent currently resolve to the same red-orange family. docs/VISUAL.md requires separating these: matte red (#B6383A) for decisive actions only, sky blue (#8CC9E8) for information/trust context.

rules.name: The Never-Red-For-Success Rule
rules.body: Success and completed states use ok (emerald), never the brand red.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Geist is the only typeface in the system; hierarchy comes from weight and size, not a second family.

rules.name: The No-Colored-Glow Rule
rules.body: Primary-tinted shadows are reserved for the single highest-stakes action per screen (currently, connect-wallet). Most surfaces use a neutral ambient shadow only.

dos: Keep amount, currency, and status as one visual group, with counterparty/date/fee as secondary metadata.
Use the neutral ambient panel shadow as the default card treatment; reserve the primary-tinted glow for one highest-stakes action per screen.
Pair every status (danger/warning/ok) with an icon and label, never color alone.
Keep Geist as the only typeface; differentiate hierarchy through weight/size only.
When migrating toward docs/VISUAL.md's target palette, split today's single red-orange into a decisive matte red (#B6383A) for actions and a separate sky blue (#8CC9E8) for informational context.
donts: Don't reintroduce the current DeFi-protocol sidebar framing (staking/governance/treasury/vaults/risk/markets as primary navigation) once the dashboard is repurposed.
Don't use literal Peru-flag bands, Machu Picchu imagery, or tourist visual clichés to imply locality.
Don't ship neon gradients, everywhere-glassmorphism, token-price charts as default decoration, or crypto-terminal grid backgrounds.
Don't carry the .dapp-panel's 32px radius forward into new surfaces without reconsidering it — 12-16px is the more disciplined target.
Don't use border-left/border-right accent stripes, gradient text, or color-only status indicators.
Don't show a payment as complete before the relevant rail confirms it, and don't imply bank status, insurance, licensure, card availability, or yield guarantees without approved evidence.
